description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering vacancy search parameters within the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as job title ID, employee number, status, name, publication state, and vacancy IDs, along with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sorting fields for vacancy search.

classes.name: VacancySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate search filter parameters for vacancies in the recruitment module. It includes properties for filtering by job title, employee number, status, name, publication status, and vacancy IDs, and initializes default sorting by vacancy name.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the vacancy is published.

methods.name: getVacancyIds
methods.description: Returns the list of vacancy IDs.

methods.name: setVacancyIds
methods.description: Sets the list of vacancy IDs.
